notes.title: AstroShift Is Available Now!
notes.notes:
I updated AstroShift to make it a bit easier.
Also, for a limited time, the Arcade is unlocked from the start!

If you like space shooters with 2D hand drawn graphics and a catchy electronic score, check out AstroShift! With more than 2 dozen ships to fly, fight back against the invading enemy fleet.
